description: One area: metadata, its dedicated site link, and a top sample of member providers (with the total). Use find_providers?area=slug for the full list, or view=full here. Results carry `next`: the sub-resources that exist for this entity and the exact tool call that retrieves each, computed from this record. Pass include_next=false to omit it.

context.description: Optional: one sentence on why you are asking. Never used to rank; read only if a result is wrong.

include_next.description: Set false to omit the `next` affordance block.

slug.description: Area slug, as find_areas returns it, e.g. "security".

name: get_area
